limitation_wording: In an item-paired difference design, contamination is primarily a CEILING risk: it lifts every arm equally and compresses the difference between them. It is not described as a threat to validity, because the paired design differences out an item-level effect common to all arms.
interpretation_ceiling: This measures overlap between the adapter's training sample and the benchmark items. It is reported alongside any accuracy figure. It is not evidence about J-space, about distillation, or about reasoning.
